artifact_audit.scope: All corpus text is scrubbed mechanically; repeated-line/source diagnostics inspect development training only. Raw lines never enter reports.

limitations: Previous v2 representatives are reused, not reclassified as fresh evidence.
Near matching operates on coarse representatives using inherited trigram/Jaccard thresholds, not all paraphrases.
Cross-date and cross-role families are quarantined in full; this reduces realistic campaign repetition.
SmishX is a relabeled multi-collection SMS holdout, not a second independent email collection.
Synthetic stress rows were previously exposed in v2; their scores are diagnostics only.
SpaPhish is one collection spanning several contributors; contributor identities cannot establish independent sources.

evidence.reason: SpaPhish is one modern real-email collection with both labels. SmishX is SMS from multiple underlying sources, not a second email collection or representative email external test.

protocol.activation: Never activate. Even all-gate pass only VALIDATED - eligible for activation review. Original model and production paths remain unchanged.
protocol.chronology: Documented historical collection bound through 2022, SpaPhish documented message dates. No invented dates from filenames, release dates or IDs. Sender dates not independently verified. Cross-period duplicate families fully quarantined.
protocol.external: SmishX sources never enter fitting, threshold selection, model selection or source-identity diagnostics. Data preparation only mechanically normalizes/deduplicates it and reports counts before sealing; evaluation text is read only after lock.
protocol.final: SpaPhish 2024-2025 (within-source, forward-time), plus fully external SmishX SMS and unknown-date/SYNTHETIC diagnostics. All opened once after all model, threshold, code, data and policy hashes are locked.
protocol.selection: Preserve v2 fixed four candidates, source-aware ranking and all gate values. Add temporal and external/evidence gates. Test cannot select model or change thresholds.
protocol.training: REAL only: existing v2 train representatives and SpaPhish dated through 2022; cap 1500 per source/class. Synthetic data only post-lock diagnostics.
protocol.validation: Thresholds use SpaPhish 2023 only. Mixed-source diagnostics and ranking include previously exposed historical v2 validation plus 2023 SpaPhish. The historical slice is not called a temporal holdout.
